release_notes.title: Interface languages and ClickUp startup reliability
release_notes.summary: Adds 14 offline interface-language choices and improves ClickUp startup draft acceptance and repeated history reads while preserving protected user content and send safeguards.
added: Choose English, Spanish, French, Russian, Arabic, Simplified or Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Italian, Hindi or Turkish in desktop, extension and bar settings.
Search language names and codes; persist the selection with existing preferences and use scoped Arabic right-to-left layout.
improved: Translate built-in interface text offline while leaving user-authored content, paths, commands and PlazCode/Ultra branding unchanged.
Cache ClickUp history reads and avoid redundant owned-message masking work during tool-result loops.
fixed: Keep the exact ClickUp composer protected but natively writable while delayed draft/model acceptance enables Send; repeated lock sweeps no longer close that acceptance window.
Stop before sending if the composer remounts or a different unsent draft is already present. Preserve exact-route rollback and never force disabled Send or replay uncertain delivery.
Retain startup staging, complete tool-result paging, native launch/update behavior and existing features.
notes: Publication requires successful exact-source browser and Linux/Windows/macOS validation plus actual packaged Mac desktop lifetime, visibility and updater-relaunch checks.

Local delayed-model tests are sanitized model-bound fixtures, not actual Quill or live ClickUp accounts. Hosted browser fixtures use a mocked bridge; a signed-in ClickUp connection and labelled feedback transport also passed without project tools. Affected accounts, Microsoft Edge binary and real project edits were not tested.
Windows binaries are unsigned. The Mac app is ad-hoc signed, not notarized. Final native bytes are reused from validated artifacts; there is no separate user test-build delivery.

github.summary: Adds 14 offline UI languages and fixes locally reproduced ClickUp acceptance and repeated-scan problems without bypassing native send safety.

sections.title: 🌐 Interface languages
items: Fourteen choices across desktop, extension and bar settings, searchable by native/English name or code.
Offline catalogs, preference persistence, scoped Arabic RTL and protected authored/technical content.

sections.title: 🛠️ ClickUp reliability
items: Protected native-editability window for delayed draft acceptance, with exact editor/route checks and remount aborts.
Different existing drafts are preserved without clicking; disabled controls are never forced and ambiguous sends are not replayed.
Cached history reads and mutation-safe masking reduce repeated work between tool calls; existing result paging and startup features remain.

sections.title: 🧪 Validation and limitations
items: Exact-source platform/browser and real packaged Mac desktop lifetime gates are required before publication; validated native bytes are not rebuilt during promotion.

Delayed-model evidence is from local sanitized fixtures, not actual Quill. Signed-in ClickUp connection/feedback transport also passed. Affected accounts, Microsoft Edge binary and real-project edits were not tested.
Windows unsigned; Mac ad-hoc signed and not notarized. GitHub provenance does not replace platform signing.

release_notes.title: ClickUp tool results and Blender command lists
release_notes.summary: ClickUp reads large tool results through complete retained pages and correctly selects Blender when its catalog request places server outside params.
improved: Send ClickUp-sized result pages while keeping every original character available through plazcode_result_read, without rerunning the original tool.
Recheck final tool feedback after appended status and reference context.
fixed: Large Blender results and full command references no longer exceed ClickUp’s outgoing transport bound.
Read-only command-list requests preserve an unambiguous top-level server selector; conflicting selectors are rejected.
notes: Exact-source Windows/macOS/Linux/browser and packaged Mac desktop checks are required before publication.
Browser fixtures use a mocked bridge; affected live ClickUp accounts and real Blender/Studio work are not claimed tested. Windows is unsigned; macOS is not notarized.

github.summary: Fixes oversized ClickUp tool feedback and Blender command-list selection.

sections.title: 🛠️ Fixes
items: Large results and complete Blender/Roblox GUI catalogs use retained pages, without repeating the operation.
Blender catalog requests preserve server when supplied outside params.
Final feedback sizing includes appended status and references.

sections.title: 🧪 Validation and limitations
items: Platform/browser and packaged Mac desktop gates run before publication.
Fixtures use a mocked bridge; affected accounts and real projects were not tested. Windows unsigned; Mac not notarized.

release_notes.title: Reliable ClickUp startup receipts
release_notes.summary: ClickUp startup continues after accepted context parts, uses compact defaults, and stops clearly when the selected AI model declines the connection.
improved: Use compact default ClickUp startup instructions and bounded saved-note previews; keep full notes available through the memory reader and preserve custom instructions exactly.
Observe a startup acknowledgement through the existing response timeout when its receipt is delayed.
fixed: Confirm each startup context part from a persisted new user row and its exact new assistant acknowledgement when rich-text rendering changes the user row.
Recognize explicit ClickUp model refusals before sending a protocol correction; leave startup stopped and the composer unlocked.
Cancel receipt observation on Stop or a known conversation change without sending again.
notes: Validated on Windows, macOS and Linux with Chromium/Firefox regressions and packaged macOS desktop checks before publishing.
Affected live ClickUp accounts were not reproduced. AI models can still decline the connection request. Windows is unsigned; macOS is not notarized.

github.summary: ClickUp startup receipt and model-refusal fixes.

sections.title: 🛠️ Fixes
items: Accepted startup parts continue after rendered text changes or delayed acknowledgements.
Compact defaults reduce startup context while preserving custom instructions.
Explicit model refusals stop without repeated handshake requests.

sections.title: 🧪 Validation and limitations
items: Windows, macOS, Linux and Chromium/Firefox checks; packaged Mac desktop lifetime checked before publication.
Affected live accounts were not reproduced. A ClickUp model can still decline. Windows unsigned; Mac not notarized.

release_notes.title: ClickUp, Ultra and recoverable Skills
release_notes.summary: Use PlazCode in ClickUp Brain and existing AI-agent chats, activate the unified Ultra effort, recover deleted skills, and find clearly labelled donation links.
added: ClickUp Ask Brain and existing AI-agent chats support the usual PlazCode Studio, Blender and local-file commands.
Deleted Skills tab with Restore, confirmed permanent deletion and a separate Delete All for deleted items.
Desktop Donations page after Templates with labelled 50, 100, 500 and 1,000 Robux links opening in the current/default browser.
improved: Ultra replaces the visible UltraCode effort label and adds animated gradient text with reduced-motion and forced-colour accessibility fallbacks.
UltraCode and UltraGUI work as hidden internal components; relevant UltraLab companion enhancements activate only at Ultra effort. The eleven starter skills remain visible.
ClickUp startup sends bounded, acknowledged context parts without truncating instructions or automatically replaying uncertain sends.
Updated donation destinations and amounts everywhere in the shared bar settings and desktop page.
fixed: ClickUp toolbar follows the actual chatbox width and position while Ask/Agents tabs stay visible and clickable.
Injected ClickUp startup/tool messages stay hidden after UI remounts; failed startup cannot restore a false Ready state.
Removed Condo Lock classification, strikes and cooldown lockouts across all supported providers, including migration of old stored locks. Other permissions and safety controls are unchanged.
notes: User-tested build 3 was approved for publication after successful ClickUp use. Exact-source Windows/macOS/Linux and Chromium/Firefox CI passed; packaged macOS desktop lifetime checks gate publication.
Older hard-deleted skills cannot be recovered. Permanent deletion is irreversible through PlazCode, not forensic erasure of external backups.
UltraLab is a bundled reference toolkit with scoped task routing. External services, credentials, dependencies and asset rights remain subject to setup and verification.
Windows is unsigned; macOS is ad-hoc signed, not notarized. Custom agents and real affected Studio/Blender/file projects are not claimed as exhaustively live-tested.

github.summary: ClickUp support, unified Ultra effort, recoverable Skills and updated donations.

Donation links are updated and clearly labelled, with a new desktop Donations page.

Condo Lock removed across supported sites; unrelated permissions remain.

sections.title: 🧪 Checks

Older hard-deleted skills are not recoverable. Windows unsigned; Mac not notarized.

release_notes.title: Co-Work cleanup, Claude replies and Studio startup
release_notes.summary: Sent Co-Work requests clear immediately, completed Claude replies are read reliably, and Studio connection starts automatically with stronger Windows launcher discovery.
improved: Discover the running Windows Studio MCP helper or a complete installed version when the batch launcher is missing.
Attempt Studio connection at app launch and retry when Studio opens later, even when process-name scans miss it.
fixed: Confirmed Co-Work follow-ups disappear immediately; queued and unconfirmed requests remain visible.
Read one owning Claude assistant turn and all non-thinking answer blocks so nested empty nodes do not hide a completed reply.
notes: Validated on Windows, macOS and Linux with Chromium/Firefox regressions and packaged macOS desktop lifetime checks.
Automated fixtures cover the reported failures; the affected live Edge account and Windows Studio installation were not reproduced. Windows is unsigned; macOS is ad-hoc signed, not notarized.
